units.source_text: 虽说是尼姑庵，可是庵主已年过六十五了。

en.t: Although it was called a nunnery, the abbess was already over sixty-five.

units.source_text: 在古都，这小小的尼姑庵也自有它的掌故。

en.t: In the old capital, even this small nunnery had its own history and lore.

units.source_text: 但庵门掩没在竹林中，看不见了。

en.t: But the gate of the hermitage was hidden in the bamboo grove and could no longer be seen.

units.source_text: 这庵几乎与观光游览无缘，显得冷冷清清的，顶多有间厢房供偶尔举办茶道会使用，而且也不是什么有名的茶室。

en.t: This hermitage had almost nothing to do with sightseeing and felt quiet and deserted; at most, it had a side room used now and then for tea gatherings, and it was not a famous tearoom either.

units.source_text: 庵主经常外出教人插花。

en.t: The abbess often went out to teach flower arrangement.
